fichas.title: Dairy Farming
fichas.summary: Overview of dairy-cow housing, lying-box design, stall arrangements, and requirements attributed to the Agricultural Investment Support Programme (AFP), the EU Eco Directive, and recommendations for horned cows. The text gives formulas for calculating lying-box dimensions from animal measurements; these formulas are summarized without deriving unprinted values.
uses: Housing dairy cows and young cattle
